sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Very depressed. Full feeling. Nervous
headache from menstrual irregularities. Aching in eye-
balls, with much lachrymation.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Uncontrollable masturbation. Spermator-
rhtta, with erotic fancies and amorous dreams. Emis-
sions, with irresistible tendency to masturbation. Dull
pain in lumbar region, with great despondency and
mental irritability.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Vicarious men.struation. [Bry.; Phos.]
Ovaries burn, pain, swell. Profuse menses after mis-
carriage; discharge of blood from slightest provocation
[Jpcc., Sabina]; bright red; partly clotted. Menor-
rhagia at climaxis. [Cah\ Lack.] Oozing of dark
blood, clotted, forming long black strings. [Argn. n.;
Croc,; Imc, r.] Uterus hypertrophied. Cervix bleed
easily. [Sulph. oc.] Postpartum haemorrhage. {Ipec.;
Sab,; 5cr.] Profuse lochia.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Abundant sweat. Pulse at first accelerated
then enfeebled. Palpitations.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Muscular debility, sensation of boiling
water along the back. Clonic and tetanic movements.
Muscular contractions, especially of lower limbs.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Alopecia. Tendency to small boils. Skin
dry ; eczema ; copper-colored spots. Pruritus ; sunburn.
Psoriasis, (internally and externally.)
